nameOrigin: the partial darkness between day and night

pokedexEntries.ru: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

pokedexEntries.sa: DUSCLOPS absorbs anything, however large the object may be. This POKéMON hypnotizes its foe by waving its hands in a macabre manner and by bringing its single eye to bear. The hypnotized foe is made to do DUSCLOPS’s bidding.

pokedexEntries.frlg: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

pokedexEntries.em: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

pokedexEntries.dp: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

pokedexEntries.pt: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
